spec.semantic_summary: Initialize the red initiator position and plane from its ant-list record. On zero state, un-recruit and either promote a randomized batch or seed red destination from LastFoodDrop and recruit according to two near factors. On state 2, use GetRedBestDirs toward the fuzzer location; an occupied target either starts YellowFight or updates the ant turn and list/map bytes. Adjacent LastFoodDrop words and unnamed threshold fields are hypotheses from segment/offset evidence.
